t: The Brenner Sticky Stuff Remover is a professional solvent-based cleaning fluid designed to lift stubborn adhesive residue. This ready-to-use liquid formula quickly dissolves glue, labels, sticky tape, grease, and tar spots from various surfaces without the need for endless scraping. Designed for a wide range of cleaning and maintenance tasks, this label remover helps restore surfaces to a clean finish with less time and effort. The 1 Ltr bottle provides ample liquid for multiple tasks, ensuring a clean finish with minimal effort.
b: Removes Sticky Marks & Residue Easily & Fast
